# 苹果最便宜笔记本 MacBook Neo 发布：搭载 A18 Pro 处理器、没有刘海，售价 4599 元起

2026/3/4 22:00:22 来源： IT之家作者：远洋 责编：远洋

评论：

IT之家 3 月 4 日消息，苹果发布 MacBook Neo，采用 4 款靓丽配色，铝金属机身设计，配备 13 英寸 Liquid 视网膜显示屏，无刘海，售价 4599 元起。

据IT之家了解，MacBook Neo 搭载了此前用于 iPhone 16 Pro的苹果 A18 Pro 处理器，采用无风扇设计，运行完全静音。通过这款更便宜的电脑，苹果旨在瞄准 Chromebook 和低端 Windows 用户，以及那些可能想要 MacBook 但觉得价格难以承受的人群。这款新电脑虽然仍采用铝合金材质，但有多种颜色可供选择。这是自 1999 年 iBook G3 以来，苹果笔记本电脑上最鲜艳的颜色。

MacBook Neo 采用铝合金机身，圆润边角设计兼具优雅外观与扎实舒适的握持感。机身重 1.23 千克，可轻松放入背包或手提包。

MacBook Neo 配备 13 英寸 Liquid Retina 显示屏，拥有 2408×1506 分辨率、500 尼特亮度、10 亿色彩支持，

MacBook Neo 配备 2 个 USB-C 端口、支持杜比全景声的双侧扬声器以及多点触控触控板。还拥有 1080p 摄像头、双麦克风和 3.5 毫米耳机插孔，部分更昂贵的版本将配备 Touch ID。

苹果承诺其电池续航时间最长可达 16 小时，并配备了两个 USB-C 端口，没有 MagSafe 充电功能。3.5mm 耳机插孔位于右侧端口面靠近前端的位置，还支持 Wi‑Fi 6E 高速无线连接与蓝牙 6.0。

苹果 MacBook Neo 的 8+256GB 版本售价 4599 元，8+512GB 版本售价 5299 元，有银色、桃粉色、柑橘黄色、靛蓝色可供选择，3 月 6 日开启预购，3 月 11 日正式发售。

The MacBook Neo is basically the M1 MacBook Air all over again. That laptop changed the game in 2020, and became the default option for just about anyone who wanted a great all-around thin-and-light laptop and could spend $1,000. The M1 Air was good enough that you could still buy a new one until last month. The Neo takes its place as Apple’s cheapest laptop, with a starting price of $599 and enough power to handle everyday tasks and last all day on a charge. It’s designed to entice students and first-time laptop buyers into Apple’s world. It will.

The Air is still better than the Neo in pretty much every way, but even the cheapest MacBook Neo is good enough to be the go-to Apple laptop for a lot of people. Actually, not just the go-to Apple laptop; the Neo’s hardware simultaneously embarrasses an entire class of affordable (and even far pricier) Windows laptops, as well as just about any Chromebook. And the thing runs on an iPhone chip.

Apple’s MacBook Neo is the laptop I’ve been waiting for and one I thought might never show up. With a starting price of $599 (or $499 with an education discount), the MacBook Neo is the most exciting piece of tech I’ve tested in years, with the potential to be the best MacBook for everyone who doesn’t already own one.

This is why I used it as my main computer for both work and personal fun for the last five days, to see if its display is fit for your favorites, if its speakers can bang with the best of them and if its battery life is worth your cash. Here’s what I think about the MacBook Neo, including whether or not you should buy one right now.

## What I liked about it

### Most of what we love about MacBooks for much less

Henry T. Casey/CNN Underscored

I always recommended the MacBook Air as the best laptop for most because it gets the little things right, starting with its design that includes a little indentation in the lid that makes it easy to open with a single hand. That perk is here as well, and unlike the sea of mostly plastic budget laptops with rare swaths of metal touches (or plastic lids that fake a brushed-metal aesthetic), the MacBook Neo has an excellent aluminum build just like Apple’s pricier notebooks.
